title: Ducts.
officialText:
Duct materials and joints shall be capable of withstanding the probable temperatures and pressures to which they are
exposed as determined in accordance with Section 513.10.1. Ducts shall be constructed and supported in accordance with Chapte r 6.
Ducts shall be leak tested to 1.5 times the maximum design operating pressure in accordance with nationally accepted practices.
Measured leakage shall not exceed 5 percent of design flow. Results of such testing shall be a part of the documentation proc edure.
Ducts shall be supported directly from fire-resistance-rated structural elements of the building by substantial, noncombustible
supports.
Exception: Flexible connections, for the purpose of vibration isolation, that are constructed of approved fire-resistance-rated
materials.
